Raydar is recruiting for a fast-growing software company seeking a Product Engineer to own the full lifecycle of user-facing product features. The role involves shaping product design, building and releasing features, gathering user feedback, making product and architecture decisions with leadership, and independently creating polished UI and UX screens.
Management Consulting
Responsibilities
Take product features from concept through implementation and release, covering interaction design and code
Collect user feedback from community conversations and interviews, prioritize what matters and resolve issues directly
Assemble UI and UX components into polished, usable screens without a dedicated design engineer
Present finished work to colleagues and users, then refine it based on their reactions
Partner with company leadership on product direction, architecture and scope decisions
Qualification
TypeScript
Product Feature Development
Interaction Design
User Experience Design
Product Launch
Product Judgment
User Interviews
Required
At least 1 year of professional engineering experience, not counting internships
Proficiency in TypeScript, including shipping production code
Experience launching new product capabilities from scratch and taking responsibility for every stage
Strong product sense, with the ability to decide what to ship and explain the reasoning
Comfort building complete product screens independently from UI and UX components
Preferred
Big tech background combined with startup experience
Active use of AI tools and developer tooling in daily work
Familiarity with the company's product as a user
Portfolio of shipped product work available to review and discuss
